title.zh: Gemini Interactions API 加入按需工具检索
title.en: Gemini Interactions API adds on-demand tool retrieval

summary.zh: Google 在 Gemini Interactions API 加入 Tool Retrieval：先给模型名字和描述，通过 tool_search 再取相关工具的参数结构，而不是一开始塞进全部 schema。Google 表示 Gemini 3.6 及更新版本支持。这与同日 LangSmith Tool Gateway 的按需发现是不同产品上的类似方向，应分开记录。
summary.en: Google added Tool Retrieval to the Gemini Interactions API: the model first sees names and descriptions, then uses tool_search to fetch parameter schemas for relevant tools, instead of loading every schema up front. Google said Gemini 3.6 and later support it. LangSmith Tool Gateway's on-demand discovery the same day is a similar idea on a different product, and is recorded separately.

brief.zh: Gemini Interactions API 增加 Tool Retrieval：先提供工具名称与描述，再按需取参数结构。官方称 Gemini 3.6 及更新版本支持。
brief.en: The Gemini Interactions API adds Tool Retrieval: names and descriptions first, then parameter schemas on demand. Google says Gemini 3.6 and later support it.

why.zh: 这是官方 API 对大工具集的上下文控制点，应与网关侧的授权和发现分开看。
why.en: An official API control point for large tool sets. Keep it separate from gateway-side auth and discovery.
